name: scroll-story
title: Scroll Story
description: A chart that stays in view while the story beside it scrolls: each step of text the reader reaches changes the chart, one point at a time. The story is told in the steps; the chart shows it.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/scroll-story

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/scroll-story.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/scroll-story';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/scroll-story

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
